name: cms-diabetes-measures
description: Diabetes clinical quality measures for the 2027 performance period: glycemic status assessment greater than 9% (CMS122v15), eye exam (CMS131v15), and kidney health evaluation (CMS951v5).

protocols.description: CMS122v15 - Diabetes: Glycemic Status Assessment Greater Than 9%

meta.title: Diabetes: Glycemic Status Assessment Greater Than 9%
meta.description: Patients 18-75 years of age with diabetes whose most recent glycemic status assessment (HbA1c or glucose management indicator) is above 9.0% or missing during the measurement period.

meta.title: Diabetes: Eye Exam
meta.description: Patients 18-75 years of age with diabetes who have not had a retinal or dilated eye exam by an eye care professional, an autonomous eye exam, or a retinopathy severity finding in the measurement period, or a negative exam in the year before it when they have no diabetic retinopathy.

meta.title: Kidney Health Evaluation
meta.description: Patients 18-85 years of age with diabetes who have not had both an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and a urine albumin-creatinine ratio (uACR) during the measurement period.
